div.head: II Cn 6
div.ab: Manslagan ⁊ mánswaran, hádbrecan ⁊ æwbrecan gebugan ⁊ gebétan, oððe of cyððe mid synnan gewítan.
Mannslagan ⁊ mánswaran, hádbrecan ⁊ ǽwbrecan gebugan ⁊ gebetan, oððe of cyððan mid synnan gewitan.
Manslagan ⁊ mansworan, hadbrecan ⁊ æwbrecan gebugan ⁊ gebetan, oððe of cyðe mid synnan gewitan.
[6] Manslagan ⁊ manswaran, hadbrican ⁊ æwbrican gebugan ⁊ gebetan, oððe of cyððe mid synne gewitan.
Homicidę, periuri, sacrorum ordinum contemptores, adulteri peniteant et emendent, aut cum peccatis suis á cognitione (sua) discedant.
Occulti homicidę, periuri, ordinum uiolatores (et) nuptiarum coniugatarum, quos Angli uocant ǽþbrece, aut cito ad pęnitentiam currant aut festinanter cum peccatis suis á regno nostro recedant.
Homicide, periuri, ordinis infractores et legis transgressores recedant et satisfaciant, aut a patria cum peccato discedant.
Mannslagan ⁊ mánswaran, hádbrecan ⁊ ǽwbrecan gebugan ⁊ gebetan oððe of cyððan mid synnan gewitan.
Manslagan and manswaran, hadbrecan and æwbrecan gebugan and gebetan, oððe of cyððe mid synnan gewitan.
Todtschläger und Meineidige, Klerus-Verletzer und Ehebrecher sollen sich unterwerfen und büssen oder mit Sünden (-de D) aus der Heimath weichen.
Let manslayers and perjurers, violators of holy orders and adulterers submit and make amends, or depart from their homeland with their sins (sin, D).
Murderers and perjurers, injurers of the clergy and adulterers shall submit and make amends or depart with their sins from their native land.
Homicides and perjurers, injurers of the clergy and adulterers, are to submit and make amends or to depart from their native land with their sins.
Murderers and perjurers, those who violate holy orders and those who violate their marriage vows shall submit and do penance or leave their native land with their sins.
